This will clearly distinguish M7's kinetics from M6/M8, which will simply exhibit standard saturation behavior once the catalyst is activated.
3. **Product Effects:** Setting P = 0.0 removes product inhibition and reversibility effects, allowing us to cleanly isolate and observe the forward activation and substrate-binding phenomena.
This combination of low catalyst and high substrate will effectively separate the remaining top candidates without collapsing their differences.
